description: Get the link the user must open to book a scheduled SYMONE trip or to request a quote for another route or date, plus reservation contacts. With route_id (from search_routes) the trip details are repeated next to the link. Booking and payment happen on symone.fr only.

need.description: 'scheduled_trip' to book a trip listed by search_routes, 'quote' to request a quote for a route or date that is not listed.

route_id.description: Optional id of a trip returned by search_routes.

name: get_booking_url
